advisor-openai.description: Use for quick, independent OpenAI technical advice, architecture and design decisions, tradeoff analysis, planning, and challenging assumptions. Do not use for implementation.

advisor-anthropic.description: Use for quick, independent Anthropic technical advice, architecture and design decisions, tradeoff analysis, planning, and challenging assumptions. Do not use for implementation.

build.description: Use for implementing code changes, running focused verification, and reporting completed work.

explore.description: Use for focused codebase exploration, tracing behavior, locating relevant files, and reporting implementation findings. Do not modify files.

review-anthropic.description: Use for an independent Anthropic code review focused on correctness bugs, regressions, architectural and call-graph changes, performance and resource-use regressions, A Philosophy of Software Design (APOSD) red flags, design risks, and missing tests.

review-openai.description: Use for an independent OpenAI code review focused on correctness bugs, regressions, architectural and call-graph changes, performance and resource-use regressions, A Philosophy of Software Design (APOSD) red flags, design risks, and missing tests.

computer-use.description: Use for authorized desktop computer use through Codex's computer-use tools, including interacting with native applications. Use Playwriter instead for browser tasks. Include the authorized actions, target applications, and stopping conditions in the child prompt; do not expand access or bypass approvals. Desktop permissions are managed by Codex, not the filesystem sandbox. Report completed actions, blockers, and any remaining changes to desktop state.

research.description: Use for web access: search authoritative sources for current documentation, release notes, pricing, and news, or fetch and extract content from a specific URL. Runs through an isolated Codex child so raw web content stays out of the parent context.
